changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Physiocracy and the natural economic order

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Revolutionary Armies, coercion and dissolution

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Revolutionary press and political scrutiny
changed_subject_access_assessments.assessment: The revised retained page sets separate journalism and suspicion from unsupported later-page claims. The existing press, Marat and aristocrat-label tasks preserve those distinct inquiries.

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Hébert and the Hébertists, rise and destruction

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Paris as self-appointed guardian of the Revolution
changed_subject_access_assessments.assessment: The corrected evidence separates page 126 municipal authorization to fire after dispersal orders from page 128 narrowing of Guard membership. The task already asks about both dependence on popular action and subsequent policing, without merging their enactment dates.

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Revolutionary reform of taxation
changed_subject_access_assessments.assessment: Moving enforcement-failure support to page 134 leaves fiscal equality and absent collection machinery explicit. No new synonym or task is needed to preserve the difference between equal assessment and political suffrage.

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Tax evasion and Babeuf's campaign against indirect taxes
changed_subject_access_assessments.assessment: Page 134 supports the collection failure previously put on 132. Babeuf/Picardy protest remains a separate named route from general tax evasion and the replacement tax system.

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Elective public office and judicial reform

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Municipal revolution in provincial towns

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Paris uprising and the storming of the Bastille,12–14 July 1789

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Public opinion as an informed tribunal and political force

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Popular food disturbances before May 1789

changed_subject_access_assessments.label: Day of Tiles at Grenoble
